applies_to: Komfovent air handling units fitted with the C5 controller.
summary: The Komfovent C5 is the built-in controller of Komfovent air handling units. It speaks BACnet IP on its RJ-45 Ethernet port (no MS/TP). The list has 237 objects: sensor readings as AIs, output signals as AOs, wired contacts as BIs, relay outputs as BOs, alarms as BVs, and all commands, setpoints and function settings as AVs. On/off, modes and enable flags are AVs with numeric codes, not binary or multistate objects.
notes: AIs, AOs, BIs, BOs and BVs are read-only; most AVs are R/W.
Flow AVs and AIs use the unit chosen in AV 72 Flow units (m3/h, l/s, m3/s or Pa).
AQC, OOD and REC setpoints take ppm, % or °C depending on the air quality sensor type fitted.
AV numbers have gaps by section: function settings use 0-57 and 77-90; alarm reset, counters and user settings use 58-76, 82 and 83.
Zone 1 / Zone 2 objects only matter when the extra zones are configured.

source.title: BACnet Connection C5 - Installation and Service Manual

integration.summary: Start and stop the unit with AV 0 Unit On/Off and pick the ventilation mode with AV 2 Mode selection (Comfort1/2, Economy1/2, Special, Program). Each mode has its own supply/extract flow and temperature setpoint AVs. Read AV 1 Current mode, the supply, extract and outdoor temperatures (AI 0-2), the alarm BVs and BO 22 Alarm DOUT; reset alarms by writing 1 to AV 58.
integration.enable: AV 0 Unit On/Off switches the unit (0 = off, 1 = on). AV 2 Mode selection picks the operating mode; 6 = Program hands control to the unit's own schedule.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 73 External room temperature sensor accepts a room temperature from the BMS; a value outside -50..+120 °C disables the override.
setup: Factory network settings: IP 192.168.0.50, mask 255.255.0.0, BACnet port 47808, BACnet ID 1100.
Change them in the controller web server (Settings > Connectivity) or on the C5.1 panel (Settings > Air handling unit > Connectivity).
Komfovent recommends a polling interval of at least 1 second.
AV 83 enables BBMD (BACnet Broadcast Management Device) on the controller.
gotchas: Commands and enable flags are AVs holding 0/1 or mode codes, not BVs or MVs.
Flow setpoint units follow AV 72; check it before writing flows.
AV 59-61 run-hour counters and AV 67-71 clock values are writable; don't write them cyclically.
AV 84 starts a heat exchanger calibration when 1 is written.
